text:
maria: quick questionwe keep hitting tenant SLOs when we hard-reject during burst windows. can we design a graceful degradation path instead of 503s?
aj: yes. proposal: soft backpressure that returns a short "defer" hint + ETA so callers can retry or route to fallback models. minimal wire changes.
sahil: main risk is cost explosion if many tenants fall back to more expensive variants. we need per-tenant budget smoothing + guardrails.
maria: thinking of a token-bank per tenant. tokens represent admission budget; local node caches a tiny pool for low-latency checks; distributed store is the source of truth for replenishment. when empty, return defer or suggest a cheaper route.
cheng: define fallback tiers: q8/q4 quantized model, lower-cost region, or a queued slow-path. prefer quantized smaller model first. also only eligible for short prompts (<512) and stateless requests.
liz: product constraint: fallbacks must be opt-in per-route and visible in Console (cost delta, fallback rate). customers can opt-out to keep hard-fails.
aj: sketch for local fast-path: atomic decrement from local cache; if miss, consult redis counter with a compare-and-swap TTL to refill local cache. replenish should be jittered.
sahil: ops: add a global saturation circuit-breaker that triggers hard-rejects if cluster-wide resource pressure exceeds threshold for >N minutes. protects cluster from overload.
maria: example config for POC:
```
admission:
  strategy: soft_backpressure
  token_bank:
    capacity: "1200"
    refill_per_min: "400"
    local_cache_size: "64"
  fallbacks:
    - kind: quantized_model
      ids: ["redwood-small-q4","redwood-compact-q8"]
    - kind: region_fallback
      regions: ["us-east-1","eu-west-1"]
  guardrails:
    max_cost_multiplier: "1.8"
    eligible_request_types: ["stateless","short"]
```
sahil: metrics to emit: tenant_bank_level, local_cache_hits, fallback_suggestions, fallback_accepts, spill_to_queue. add alert if fallback_cost_delta > threshold.
aj: API signal: add response header `X-RW-Admission: defer;eta=30;hint=compact-q8` and a structured JSON body on SDKs so clients can programmatically act.
cheng: caution: model fallback invalidates KV cache and may increase compute due to warmups. only allow model fallback when prompt_len < 512 and no conversation state. otherwise prefer region or queue fallback.
liz: product rollout: feature-flag default off; opt-in internal customers; show Console charts for per-route fallback rate and cost impact; allow per-tenant `admission.mode: hard|soft`.
maria: rollout/checklist: small-scale canary -> internal load tests simulating bursty tenants -> SLO tests for latency/cost -> Gradual ramp with flag and alerts.
aj: i'll prototype redis-backed token bank + local cache and PR the header surface. estimate 1 week for POC.
sahil: i'll add chaos tests (spike failure, redis latency) to ensure graceful behavior and verify circuit-breaker kicks in.
deploy-bot: feature-flag `admission.soft_backpressure` enabled in staging :white_check_mark:
liz: i'll draft a short RFC section capturing semantics and product UX; will tag reviewers.
maria: cool. meeting Friday 10:30 to review POC results. thanks.
